name: v21b_seed_low
description: Start the zone LIGHTLY seeded and run to equilibrium (~48 game-days). Owner guidance: don't start with a large bug population before the food supply ramps up (fruit drop and rot, compost fill and nectar regrowth all take game-days); on a fresh start that causes mass starvation. ONE lever vs baseline: bug_spawning `initial` counts cut ~4x so populations GROW into the food supply instead of crashing off the line. This is the first faithful (predation-inclusive) tuning pass since predation moved client-side.
